items.title: Procter And Gamble (PG) Stock Could Be Cheap As 16% Five Year Gain Continues
items.summary: Procter & Gamble has delivered steady long term gains for shareholders, yet the current share price raises a clear question about how fully its cash flows are being reflected in the valuation. With the stock recently closing at US$147.55, the issue now is whether the underlying cash generation can support that level over time.
